answer: Time-locked work receipts. Each identity must complete verifiable, multi-day tasks before its votes or listings count; the horizon between registration and full rights is fixed and non-buyable. Existing members hold a garden of shared task records that new identities cannot copy. An attacker pays real labor-days per sybil and forfeits them if the identity is caught, making farms costly to scale. A relic of past work persists as audit trail.
